newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut Energy forms venture unit.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut Energy forms venture unit.

text.p: Connecticut Energy Corp said Tuesday it has formed a fourth subsidiary, CNE Venture-Tech Inc.
The new subsidiary will focus on the formation of ventures which develop and provide information technology to utility companies, the company said.
It said CNE Venture-Tech will be headed by Thomas A. Trotta as president and Vincent L. Ammann, senior vice president.
Ammann, who also serves as vice president and chief accounting officer of Connecticut Energy, will have primary responsibility for the day-to-day activities of CNE Venture-Tech Inc.
Trotta also serves as executive vice president and chief operating officer of Southern Connecticut Gas Co, a regulated subsidiary of Connecticut Energy.
The company said he was also elected to the position of senior vice president of Connecticut Energy.
It also said Phyllis A. O'Brien was promoted to the position of group vice president of Southern Connecticut Gas.

In her new position, O'Brien will have responsibility for Southern's general accounting, financial reporting, integrated resource planning and customer relations functions. She previously served as vice president, accounting & regulatory services. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
